description: Run a complete region set and gene set enrichment analysis on your own data: region overlap enrichment (LOLA), genomic region enrichment of annotated terms (rGREAT), region TFBS motif enrichment (pycisTarget), gene TFBS motif enrichment (RcisTarget), and gene over-representation analysis (ORA) and preranked GSEA (GSEApy). Every tool applies its own multiple-test correction; the workflow produces per-set enrichment plots, per-group summary plots, and reproducibility exports (configs/ and envs/). Official port of epigen/enrichment_analysis v3.0.1 with tool versions and commands pinned to the source.
name: Region set and gene set enrichment: LOLA, GREAT, pycisTarget and GSEA
